reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Edit Teams 類別時，可刪除全部主隊或逐筆刪除主隊。為什麼這樣切：與 118 的條款正文逐字相同，僅類別名稱不同（A-SX17），切分依該唯一差異。逐筆刪除的 ER 同時斷言其餘主隊未受影響，排除「刪一筆即清空」的實作；兩種刪除在同一顆內依序驗證，因第二種的前置狀態正是第一種的結果，無須另建情境。

tcs.tc_title: Edit Teams deletes an individual favorite team and all of them
tcs.test_item: When the Edit Teams category is selected, the HU shall enable the user to delete all current favorite teams or delete individual favorite team entries
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three teams are set as favorite teams
5. The Game Zone browse content is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Edit Teams category
2. Delete one individual favorite team and read the favorite teams
3. Delete all current favorite teams and read the favorite teams
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Edit Teams category is accepted as a selection and both deleting an individual entry and deleting all are offered
2. The deleted team is no longer a favorite team and the other two are unchanged
3. No favorite team remains
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Same-text sibling: CFTS024-4872916 (category-name entry is the distinguishing token)
